_comment: TEMPLATE — copy this to clients.local.json (gitignored) and put REAL client watches there. NEVER add real client names to this file or to feeds.json: both are committed to a PUBLIC repo. Same topic schema as feeds.json. Optional per-topic 'lookback_days' widens the recency window (e.g. 30) for slower-cadence brand/pharma news. Optional 'clinicaltrials_sponsor' and 'pubmed_query' enrich pharma/biotech watches via those connectors (omit for non-pharma clients). Optional 'account_scope' (free text) describes your actual engagement/remit with this account — leadership-radar uses it to weight relevance and mark each read in-scope vs. adjacent, and to pick the cross-client triage line.

topics._tier_note: leadership-radar: 'primary' = always gets a prose block (even 'quiet this period'); 'context' = block only on a material event, else a coverage-table row. MD owns tiering by strategic priority (spend + growth/pilot + renewal/risk), not spend alone.
topics.pubmed_query: <drug or asset name — biomedical only, else omit>
topics.account_scope: <e.g. 'AOR for HCP media on <brand>; piloting <other division>' — omit if not yet known>
